answer: Funding-origin auditing: an agent mints identity only by locking a refundable timber-bond traced to one real funding source, and that bond vests slowly over many epochs of distinct verified work, so it cannot be bought in bulk. A swarm of clones sharing a single origin paints the same pigment signature across the provenance graph; auditors then collapse that nebula of look-alike identities into one slashable cluster and burn every linked bond at once. Honest cost stays linear per independent funder, while a thousand sybils need a thousand separately funded bonds.
